SPACELIFT_API_KEY_ENDPOINT.description: Your account's GraphQL endpoint. An address.

SPACELIFT_API_KEY_ID.description: Half of the pair. Documented as twenty-six characters, which is the only shape declared here. Spacelift does not separate this half as publishable, so it stays with the other.

SPACELIFT_API_KEY_SECRET.description: Spacelift says to save it on your end because it does not store the token, and it can be neither retrieved nor recreated afterwards.

SPACELIFT_API_TOKEN.description: A session token exchanged in advance, so a run need not exchange one itself. Spacelift describes this path as static credentials and prefers OIDC to it.
